company.name: Trailhead
company.description: A hiking app: plan routes, record hikes with GPS and keep a history of every trail. Trailhead Plus adds offline maps and 3D views.

title: Trailhead: a month of feedback
brief: Trailhead's inbox for the last 30 days holds 55 pieces of feedback: app reviews, support tickets and NPS comments. The PM who used to triage it has left, and the team plans the next quarter on Monday. Group the feedback into themes, set the noise aside, flag anything critical, rank the themes by what matters, and write opportunities for the top ones.

themes.label: Recorded hikes disappear
themes.summary: A sync change in the latest release overwrites local history with an empty server copy. People lose years of recorded hikes, and it gets worse every day the release stays live.
themes.opportunity: How might we guarantee that a recorded hike is never lost, starting with stopping the sync bug and restoring the deleted history?

themes.label: The app crashes
themes.summary: Crashes in core flows. People lose work and cannot finish what they came to do.
themes.opportunity: How might we catch crashes in core flows before release, and fix the top crash signatures this sprint?

themes.label: Getting started is confusing
themes.summary: New users struggle with the first steps. It costs activation quietly: these people rarely complain twice, they just leave.
themes.opportunity: How might we get a new user to record a hike in their first two minutes, without a tutorial?

themes.label: The app got slow
themes.summary: Load times and responsiveness got worse over recent releases. It annoys everyone a little and pushes some people away, but nobody is blocked.
themes.opportunity: How might we make opening Trailhead and loading routes feel instant again, with a load-time budget every release has to meet?

themes.label: The price feels too high
themes.summary: Complaints about the price and the last increase. Loud and frequent, but people still use the product; it is a positioning question, not a broken experience.
themes.opportunity: How might we make the value of Trailhead Plus obvious before renewal, so the price feels earned?

themes.label: Requests for offline maps for Europe
themes.summary: A popular request. It signals what people want next, but its absence does not hurt anyone today.
themes.opportunity: How might we find out which job offline maps for Europe would do for people, and whether a smaller version solves it?

themes.label: Too many notifications
themes.summary: Push and email volume annoys people. Easy to fix and worth fixing, but it does not stop anyone from using the product.
themes.opportunity: How might we let people choose which notifications they get, and send fewer that matter more?

hidden.explanation: The critical problem, "Recorded hikes disappear", appears in only 5 items, all from the last 6 days. Few items, but each describes harm that grows every day it stays live, so it goes first whatever the volume. Volume alone would put "Getting started is confusing" next, with 12 items, but it is a medium-severity problem. "The app crashes" (8 items, high severity) and "Getting started is confusing" (12 items, medium severity) hurt more people more. Impact here is reach times severity: low counts 1, medium 2, high 3 per item. 6 items were noise: praise, spam and off-topic messages that belong in no theme.
hidden.principle: Rank feedback by reach times severity, not by volume, and read the rare, recent and severe items first: a critical problem is usually quiet before it gets loud.
